name: zeffect_find_template_index_by_name
description: zEffect::FindTemplateIndexByName scans the runtime template table for an exact effect-name match and returns the matching index.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x462280 is limited by the x86 inline-strcmp sbb flag idiom. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x462280 validates returning -1 when templateCount is non-positive, then scanning g_zEffect_RuntimeManager.templates in 0x48-byte entries and returning the first index whose effectName compares equal to the requested name.
The native smoke verifies first and middle entry matches, missing-name -1, and empty-table -1 behavior.
